summary: Describes an extension to Extensible Provisioning Protocol (EPP) object mappings that lets an organization be assigned to any existing object, such as a domain, host, or contact, and to future objects. It works with the organization mapping in RFC 8543. It is on the standards track.

eli5.summary: This lets you stick an organization label onto a domain record, like putting a name tag on a box to show who it belongs to.
